## Evidence

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make package`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has an executable regression
- [ ] Unsupported scenarios remain visible and attributable

## Contract review

- [ ] Check state, substantive label, and runtime qualifier remain independent
- [ ] Static evidence is not described as runtime selection or causality
- [ ] Discovery, inspection, disclosure, and modification scopes do not expand
- [ ] Unknown, partial, stale, incompatible, or unreadable evidence abstains
- [ ] Model output, if any, is consented, cited, inferred, and locally adjudicated
- [ ] Repair remains manual/proposal-only unless every apply/rollback invariant passes
- [ ] Execution failure and policy-threshold failure remain distinct
- [ ] No unmeasured accuracy, usefulness, calibration, or release claim is added
